correctness.rationale: For a static maximal set containing j the two residual paths have lengths max(0,j-2) and max(0,n-j-1); the Padovan decomposition at the left endpoint has the stated initial values. Conditional on the priority t at j the arms are independent, each endpoint survival function obeys E_l'=-E_(l-1), with E_0=1 and E_l(0)=1. This yields the product integral. In the reflected half for n>=23 the static ratio involves two normalized path counts S_m/p^m at m>=10. The positive convex recurrence propagates their interval from indices 10,11,12 and propagates the upper envelope B_7 from B_6,B_7,B_8. For j>=6 both truncated exponentials have degree at least five, are in [0,1], and give integrated product error at most 2/7!. For j<=5 the long arm contributes at most 1/20!, with the five limiting integrals verified by exact integration by parts. The independently checked rational comparisons have positive absolute margins (interior lower gap about 0.00128922). First-arrival recursion and direct enumeration of occupied gaps 2 or 3 separately reproduce all signs for n=13..25, including Q_13(7)-U_13(7)=-195887/2399997600.
residual_risks: The finite independent recursion and enumeration are not extrapolated; the rational envelopes and recurrence prove the tail. No conclusion about joint site-indicator laws beyond the stated one-point marginals is needed.
